messages:
DeployBot: rolling out rl-ratecap v4 -> v5 to canary (10% traffic) now. change: exemption-matching refactor. whoami: deploy/2026-06-12-14:00 :rocket:

IncidentBot: PAGER > high error rate: /v1/generate returning 429s from canary hosts (service=rl-ratecap, region=eu-west). triggered at 14:05 UTC. paging: @Ram (oncall) :rotating_light:

Ram (oncall): I'm on it. looking at canary logs now. linking traces.

Alyssa (SRE): I see a surge of 429s from the rate-limiter shard group canary-3. Metrics: 5xx stable, 429 spiked from 0.2% -> 18% of requests.

Jon (Eng): confirmed. quick grep of config diff shows the exemption matcher now requires an explicit token_type header instead of falling back to account_id. suspect non-exempt traffic lost exemption.

Ram (oncall): can we flip the canary flag back to v4? what's the verdict for rollback vs kill-switch?

Alyssa (SRE): kill-switch the feature flag for rl-ratecap-v5 -> disable canary routing. that's fastest. rolling back will take 6-8min. kill-switch -> immediate traffic re-routing.

Jon (Eng): executing kill-switch now: `/ops/flags disable rl-ratecap-v5.canary`

DeployBot: Flag change accepted. routing policy reverted for 100% of canary buckets back to v4.

Ram (oncall): 14:12 UTC: 429s dropping. monitoring... :white_check_mark:

IncidentBot: customer-impact check: Approx 12k 429 responses during 14:05-14:12 window. Preliminary set of customers with elevated retries: tenant-phi, tenant-zen, tenant-alpha.

Tara (Support): pinging accounts team to surface to affected customers. drafting a short blameless note.

Maria (Product): prioritize a postmortem and impact classification. Suggest classification: Sev2 (partial outage affecting specific tenants with retries and degraded UX).

Alyssa (SRE): root cause summary so far: a refactor to exemption-matching in rl-ratecap v5 introduced a stricter header-based lookup. If requests didn't include token_type header (legacy SDKs), they were not matched as exempt leading to over-throttling for reserved accounts.

Jon (Eng): reproducer (local):
```
# simulate legacy header-less request
curl -s -X POST https://canary-rl.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SECRET" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -v
```
Response: 429 with body `{"error":"rate_limit"}`

Alyssa (SRE): short-term mitigation: re-enable fallback account_id matching on canary hosts and re-run canary with a small controlled pass. Engineering will ship a patch to add backward-compatible matcher.

Jon (Eng): patch PR created: github.com/redwood/rl-ratecap/pull/458 — includes tests for headerless tokens and adds deprecation log.

Ram (oncall): handoff plan: I'll keep paged guard for another 30m, then hand to SRE rotation. If 429 > 1% for 10m, escalate back to eng.

Tara (Support): Logged ticket INC-10981 for tenant-phi/zen/alpha with retries and elevated latency. Notifying AMs with mitigation steps and ETA for full fix (ETA ~ 2h).

Maria (Product): Please capture customer-visible timeline and number of impacted requests for postmortem. Also confirm if any downstream billing/token accounting inconsistencies.

Alyssa (SRE): quick accounting check: token ledger shows no token double-counting. The issue caused 429s, so fewer tokens consumed, not more. Billing risk low.

IncidentBot: runbook actions recorded: 1) kill-switch flag flip (ram) 2) routing revert (DeployBot) 3) patch PR (jon) 4) support tickets (tara) 5) postmortem owner (maria).

Jon (Eng): deploying hotfix to canary now (patch 458). will monitor canary for 10m, then promote.

DeployBot: hotfix deployed to canary at 14:37 UTC.

Ram (oncall): monitoring: 429s back to baseline, canary stable for 12m. handing off to SRE rotation. leaving notes in ops-channel.

Alyssa (SRE): next steps for postmortem: timeline, root cause (refactor + missing compatibility test), mitigation (restore fallback matcher + add suite), action items: add pre-deploy synthetic test that simulates legacy SDK headers, add rollback checklist that includes flags for immediate kill-switch, update runbook.

Maria (Product): I'll own customer comms draft. aim to send by EOD.

Tara (Support): I added affected customer list + sample logs to INC-10981.

Jon (Eng): follow-up PR to add deprecation header logging and 2s grace match inbound. PR link: github.com/redwood/rl-ratecap/pull/462

Ram (oncall): 15:03 UTC — handoff complete to SRE rotation. If anything regresses, page me. good job team. :clap:

Alyssa (SRE): tagging for postmortem: @maria (owner), @jon (fix owner), @ram (initial oncall), @tara (customer comms).
